name: Morning dashboard
description: Your calendars and local weather over the day’s selected artwork.

settings.label: Weather location
settings.description: City and state or country, for example Boston, MA. Leave blank to disable weather.

settings.label: Daily calendar sync at
settings.description: Download and prepare calendars at this local time, independently of screen refresh. A new installation syncs immediately.

settings.label: Calendar timezone
settings.description: Leave blank to follow the Art Frames timezone. Enter an IANA name, for example America/New_York, to use a different one for the daily sync and calendar display.

settings.label: Download calendars
settings.description: Daily sync runs at the time above. Screen renders reuse saved data. Calendar edits after a download appear at the next sync; restarting the layout reuses today’s saved export.

settings.label: Calendar download timeout
settings.description: Downloads run in the background. The screen can render saved calendar data while a slow feed updates.

settings.label: Calendars
settings.description: Add the Google calendars you want to combine. Each private iCal link is stored securely with this layout. Remove a calendar to stop including it.

fields.label: Title (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to use the name from the iCal feed.

fields.label: Private iCal link
fields.description: Google Calendar → Settings → Integrate calendar → Secret address in iCal format. Leave blank after saving to keep the existing link.
